description: Source code for channel management in wireless device driver, including functions for channel properties, DFS detection, frequency calculations, and band timing.

methods.name: wld_channel_is_dfs_band
methods.description: Checks if a given channel and bandwidth contain DFS channels.

methods.name: wld_channel_getDfsPercentage
methods.description: Returns the percentage likelihood that a band is DFS based on channel and bandwidth.

methods.name: wld_channel_getFrequencyOfChannel
methods.description: Retrieves the frequency in Hertz for a given channel specification.

methods.name: wld_channel_get_center_channel
methods.description: Returns the center channel of a band (obsolete, use swl_chanspec_getCentreChannel).

methods.name: wld_channel_get_band_clear_time
methods.description: Calculates the clear time in milliseconds for a band.

methods.name: wld_channel_get_band_bg_clear_time
methods.description: Calculates the background clear time in milliseconds for a band.

methods.name: wld_channel_is_long_wait
methods.description: Checks if a band is a long wait band (deprecated).

methods.name: wld_channel_is_long_wait_band
methods.description: Determines if any channel in the band is in the extended clear time band.

methods.name: wld_channel_is_long_wait_channel
methods.description: Checks if a specific channel is in the extended clear time band.

methods.name: wld_channel_is_chan_in_band
methods.description: Checks if a test channel is within the specified band (obsolete).

methods.name: wld_channel_hasChannelWidthCovered
methods.description: Checks if the channel specification covers a certain bandwidth.

methods.name: wld_channel_getExtensionChannel
methods.description: Determines the extension channel position based on channel width and current position.
